name: Credit Memo
description: Generate institutional-grade Credit Memorandums in minutes. Automatically collects 3–5 years of financial data from SEC EDGAR, SerpApi, and major rating agencies. Outputs branded Word, PDF, and PowerPoint with 10 embedded charts, inline citations, and a 5-layer compliance guardrails system. Supports public and private companies.
longDescription:
Ships **9 skills**, **5 commands** and **6 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (9): `data-collection` (Orchestrates data collection for Credit Memo generation), `document-generation` (Compiles all analyzed sections and charts into professional Word (.docx), PDF, and PowerPoint (.pptx) output files), `financial-analysis` (Performs deep financial analysis of a company for credit assessment purposes), `guardrails` (Five-layer compliance and safety enforcement for all Credit Memo plugin commands), `industry-analysis` (Conducts deep industry analysis for credit assessment, including market size, CAGR, competitive landscape, SWOT analysis, named company's market…), `management-assessment` (Assesses the quality, experience, governance, and strategic execution of a borrower's management team and board of directors for…), `repayment-analysis` (Analyzes a borrower's capacity to repay a proposed loan), `risk-assessment` (Performs comprehensive risk assessment for credit decisions), and 1 more
- **Commands** (5): `generate-credit-memo` (Generate a complete Credit Memorandum with full financial, risk, repayment, industry, and management analysis), `industry-snapshot` (Generate a standalone industry analysis report for a given sector or for the industry of a named company), `quick-risk-check` (Run a rapid 2-minute preliminary risk screen on a company), `refresh-data` (Re-fetch the latest data for a previously analyzed company, compare against the prior Credit Memo baseline, and flag…), `setup` (Configure API keys and validate Credit Memo plugin connectivity)
- **MCP servers** (6): `sec-edgar`, `serpapi`, `stock-analysis`, `discoverci`, `macrotrends`, `spherical-insights`

Installs with `claude plugin install credit-memo@claude-community` from `anthropic-plugin/credit-memo-plugin`.
